This is a Debug-build-only assert: `MaybeODRUseExprs.empty() && "Leftover expressions for
odr-use checking"` in clang::Sema::ActOnFinishFunctionBody (tools/clang/lib/Sema/SemaDecl.cpp).
Compiler Explorer only runs Release DXC builds, which compile asserts out under NDEBUG, so
every pane below is expected to succeed cleanly and print valid SPIR-V/DXIL. That is real
evidence that Release binaries are unaffected -- it is NOT evidence the underlying assert is
fixed. The assert reproduces on a local assert-enabled Debug build of main and is unrelated to
`-spirv`: removing it still trips the same assert.
